title: silene flavescens subsp. thessalonica
intro: Silene flavescens subsp. thessalonica, commonly known as Balkan catchfly, is a plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering benefits such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Silene flavescens subsp. thessalonica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
